req.title: Reject player creation with invalid id type
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer.
triggers: reject player creation with invalid id type

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-035 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id field that is not an integer. The PlayerRequestModel uses Pydantic with strict type coercion for squad_number (int). We need: (1) a positive case confirming valid integer squad_number yields 201, (2) negative cases confirming string, float-string, boolean-string, and null id values yield 422, (3) boundary cases around the type boundary (e.g., numeric string that looks like int but is a string type, and a float value). The 'id' referenced in the requirement maps to the squad_number field in PlayerRequestModel since that is the only integer identity field accepted in the POST body (the UUID 'id' is server-generated). We test multiple invalid id/squad_number type inputs to kill mutations on the 422 status constant and the type-check logic.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 is not in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload where squad_number is an integer (99)
expected: Response body contains the created player with squadNumber == 99
trace: R-PLAYER-035: valid integer id must succeed (positive path confirms 422 is not returned for valid input)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201()

from main import app

        "lastName": "Player",

from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_numeric_string_squad_number_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": "27",
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
